seo.title: Snooze — Sleep Sounds with a Sleepy Moon
seo.description: Sleep sounds for iPhone with a sleepy friend. Mix rain, waves, fire, forest and noise, and Snooze the moon dresses for every sound and drifts off with you as the timer fades out. No accounts, no subscriptions.

hero.label: SLEEP SOUNDS
hero.title: Sleep sounds with a sleepy friend.
text: Mix calm sounds and Snooze the moon dresses for every one, then drifts off with you as the timer fades out. Every sound is made on your iPhone as it plays.
